description: 修正大廳貼圖繪製時四欄位資料被當成三欄位解包，保留全部原有功能與分批載入。
fixes: Restore inventory Back-to-menu and Close-to-world as separate actions
Restore keyboard fallback without duplicate actions
Preserve existing NPC dialogue, shop, equipment, maps, quickbar, and scene navigation
Retain legacy Pygame smoke test and add key-preservation regression checks
Map and NPC assets are decoded over multiple frames with visible progress
Keep existing synchronous MapRenderer.load API for older checks
Display recoverable diagnostics rather than a frozen last frame
Draw streamed decal sprites with backward-compatible 3-/4-field tuples; preserve existing art and NPC systems
